description: Get a job started by generate_3d or generate: its status, progress, credits charged and refunded, and — when it has finished — the result files with their public download URLs, including other formats where the model returned them. Poll about every 5–10 seconds while status is pending or processing; stop when is_terminal is true.

job_id.description: The job id returned by generate_3d or generate.

name: get_job

refunded.description: Returned to the balance for outputs that failed.

files.description: Result files with public download URLs; empty until ready.

alternates.description: The same model in other formats the provider returned.

asset_id.description: The output file id inside the job.

format.description: File format, e.g. 'glb', 'fbx', 'png'; null if unknown.

role.description: What the output is within its job, e.g. 'normal' for a map.

is_terminal.description: True once the job is final and will not change again.

progress.description: 0 to 1: finished outputs over expected outputs.

status.description: pending and processing are running; success, partial, failed and canceled are final. 'partial' means some outputs finished and the rest were refunded.

title: Get job status and results
